system.description:
You must be under the effects of a Sword Aura: Primary to cast this jutsu. When you cast this jutsu, you end concentration of Sword Aura: Primary as this jutsu takes its place. At the beginning of each of your turns, select one of the listed secondary colors which your weapons color shifts to match, gaining the listed effects.

Green: Your weapons damage type becomes either Cold or Lightning which you choose each time you deal damage with it. Additionally, a creature you deal damage to with this weapon reduces their speed by 10 feet until the beginning of your next turn and treats constructs and structures as vulnerable to its damage.

Orange: Your weapons damage type becomes either Fire or Lightning which you choose each time you deal damage with it. Additionally, a creature you deal damage to with this weapon can be pushed 5 feet into a direction of your choice (except upwards) and treats constructs and structures as vulnerable to its damage.

Purple: Your weapons damage type becomes either Fire or Cold which you choose each time you deal damage with it. Additionally, a creature you deal damage to with this weapon can be pushed 5 feet into a direction of your choice (except upwards) and reduces their speed by 10 feet until the beginning of your next turn.
